question.whyItMatters: The billing administrator calls overdue clients every Friday.

text.text: Your billing desk in one place. Log hours under Time entries, turn Unbilled time into Invoices, and watch Overdue and Part paid invoices so nothing slips. Tracking only; client trust accounting stays in your accounting system.
Good time entries get paid. Vague ones get written down.
Log time the same day, in tenths of an hour.
Start with a verb and say what was done and why.
Everyone reviews their own Unbilled entries on Friday.
The billing administrator lists entries older than two weeks and asks owners to confirm them.
Open Time entries and filter Unbilled.
Group by matter and send each attorney a pre-bill summary.
Record any write-downs and agree final amounts.
Create the invoice from the client and mark the entries On draft invoice.
Mark the invoice Sent and the entries Billed.
Set a follow-up date on the due date.
Polite, regular follow-up collects more than a single loud reminder.
The day after the due date: friendly email, mark Overdue.
One week later: call the billing contact.
Two weeks later: partner calls the client.
Enter each payment in Paid and keep the balance visible in the invoice.
All time entered for the month
Overdue list reviewed with the partner
Matters over budget flagged to the attorney
